book.name: 1 Qoronttoosa
book.title: Phawuloosa Qoronttoosa Asuntsis Xaafide Tiino Kiita

content: Ekken gele bazi
Yin taas xaafide kiittis mahita hyanno. Fettii asi maacho bochchikaayzar yeziko lo77o.
Yezin olaleppa attodes fetes fetes machcha yesse; mahi fettis fettis azinii yesse.
Azinze fa machchitis, machchitan fa azinzes koshshize baz kuntso.
Machchitis fa ashtilla afa iis adetits wolqqa baaya, yezin adetits wolqqa I azinzes. Yinnii fana, azinzes E ashtilla afa adetits wolqqa baaya, yezin adetits wolqqa machchitis.
Yin woosara eerats wode gam7odes zorera maaqqanxiko, fete feta kayppete. Yinnii gisho yin yinttana ahodes gamin, Xalahe yinttana fattanaame gaar wolla yezote.
Yezin taanii yinttana zorodes hyanno gaane fattin kiita baaya.
Asi ubba ta gaar machcho ekkikaayzara yezako kadhane, yezin Xoozii fetes fetes inggide dumma imo yene. Fetes hyannii fana imo hyankkays yinnii fana imo yene.
Machcho ekkikaayzuntsisin azinii gelikaayzuntsisin mahi azinii hyayqqiduntsis taanii gaazanna, ta gaar ekkikaayzara woy gelikaayzara yezote ga7i zorane.
Yezin amora eexinttizannippa ekkizannan gelizanna lo77o maaqqide gisho un fana ahodes dandda7anxiko, ekkon gele.
Taanii ekkiduntsanan geliduntsana hyannigaara ga7i zorane; tana baayzin Laatstsii kiittane; machchita fa azinzeppa shaakkinttippe.
Yezin shaakkinttiko melle azinii gelikaayzara faas yezo woy fa azinzera giigo. Azinze fa machchito billippe.
Yezin melluntsis Laatstsii baayzin taanii hyannigaara gaane. Ammanoose machcha yeze ammanze azinii yeziko, E machchita eera fettilla yessades koyko izo dakkippe.
Mahi ammanoose azinii yeze ammanze machcha yeziko, I azinze iira fettilla yessades koyko eeppa dakkinttippe.
Ammanoose azinze fa ammanze machchiti baggara geezhane; mahi ammanoose machchita fa ammanze azinze baggara geezhane. Yinna baayzako, un na7untsi tuna maaqqane, yezin hyatte un geeshi.
Yezin ammanoose azinze woy machchita billodes koyko billo. Ammanze machcha woy azinii yinnii gaarze bazara acinttoos. Xoozii nuna sarora yessade gaar xeegida.
Ammanze maachite, neenii ammanoose ne azinza ashshod yezako akko ere? Woy ammanze azinzayo, neenii ammanoose ne machchito ashshod yezako akko ere?
Xoozii yinttana xeegidanni gaar yezote
Fettii fettii as Laatstsii ees inggide imotitsite Xoozii eza xeegidanni gaar yezo. Woosa keetstsa ubba taanii tamaarsside wogita hyanno.
Ooden garrazinttii ammanida maaqqiko, garrazinttikaayze fana yi7ippe. Garazinttii ammanide ooden yeziko, garrazinttodes koyppe.
Xoozze kiitto folodes beezane fattin garrazinttin garrazinttanxi ashshin akkon maaddoos.
Fettii fettii asi Xoozii eza xeegize wodite yezanni fana yezo.
Xoozii nena xeegide wodite neenii aro? Akko baaya yinnis un77inttippe. Yezin neenii arotitsappa wallo kessades dandda7iko neeppa attippe kezo.
Aro maaqqii yezitera Laatstse gidda xeeginttide asi Laatstse gidda arotitsappa wallo kezida. Yinnii gaar, aro maaqqikaayzara yezitera, Laatstse gidda xeeginttide asi Kiristtoosa aro.
Xoozii yinttana wagar wonggide gisho as aro maaqqippete.
Ta ishuntso, yin fete fete xeeginttide wode yeze yestte Xoozara wolla yezote.
Ekkikaayzen, gelikaayze asunts bazin azinii hyayqiduntsi baz
Wuduruntsibaz Laatstsii tana kiittidebaz baaya. Yezin Laatstsii taas inggide maarotitsite ammaninttidaya maaqqii ta yinttana zorane.
Yikke, hyatte madhiti gisho ekkikaayzara woy gelikaayzara yessii taas lo77o aazane.
Ne machcho ekkezebaz maaqqiko, billodes koyppe. Ne machcho ekkikaayzebaz maaqqiko, ekkodes koyppe.
Yezin ne machcho ekkiko nagara baaya. Yinnii gaar wudurttan azinii geliko nagara baaya. Yezin ekkizen gelize asuntsis hyanna sa7ite gaama madha yeze gisho yinttii yinnippa attode gaar ta koyane.
Ta ishuntso, ta gaazanna hyanno; wode hyal7ida. Yikkeppa tiino machcha yeze machcho ekkikaayze gaar yezo.
Yeekkizuntsi yeekkoosse gaar, ufayttizuntsi ufayttoosse gaar, wonggizuntsi akkon baayzuntsi gaar fana faydo.
Hyanna sa7a qoltte maadinttizuntsi maadinttoosse fana yii7i yezo. Hyanna alamtti bishshita aadhoda.
Yin yirga baytsi yessade gaar ta kadhane. Machcho ekkikaayze Laatstsa ufayssodes koyze gisho Laatstse baz qoppane.
Yezin machcho ekkiday fa machchito ufayssodes koyze gisho hyanna sa7itibaz qoppane.

E qoftta lam77i bessa shaakkinttane. Azinii gelikaayze wudurtta fa ashiten fa shemppite geezhi Laatstsa ufayssodes koyze gisho Laatstsi baz qoppane. Yezin azinii gelidanna fa azinza ufayssodes koyze gisho sa7abaz qoppane.
Taanii yinno yinttis ohizanna, yin maadinttode gaar ga7i fattin yinttana un77itsodes baaya. Yezin yin qoftta shaakkinttikaayzin wogara yezii Laatstsa ufayssize baz yin oochchode gaar taanii ohine.
Ooden fa oocide wuduritis gelize wode aadhida ga7i izo ashshodes qoppiko, yinna mahi iis lo77o maaqqoosanna ees sinttiko, fa koydanno oochcho; un ekkon, gelon; yinne nagara baaya.
Yezin fettii asi un7itsizebaz dhabin, fa wozintte miinggi, fana naagii, fa oocide wudurito ekkanxi ashshodes koyko loytsida.
Yinnii gisho, wudurito ekkize atstse loytsida; mahi ekkoosse atstse gaama loytsida.
Machchita fa azinze faxa yeze wode ubba eera acinttida. Yezin I azinze hyayqqiko, fa koyde azinii gelodes dandda7ane. Maaqqoyezin, iza gelize dhiiratse ammanze as maaqqades beezane.
Ta qofa maaqqiko, iza gelikaayzara yeziko ufayssara yessada. Mahi taasin, taara Xoozze Ayyaana yeza aazane.
